title: bug: taskless-handoff.test.mjs ps1 slice runs WT-04's unstubbed Initialize-MoeWorktree, so 14 claimed-worker tests fail under Windows node
description: Repro on a pure HEAD snapshot (8e20bf9e): `git archive HEAD scripts docs | tar -x -C $H && cd $H && "/mnt/c/Program Files/nodejs/node.exe" --test scripts/tests/taskless-handoff.test.mjs` gives 106 tests, 92 pass, 14 fail. All 14 are the claimed-worker/resume cases, 7 on powershell and 7 on pwsh. Each fails with "Initialize-MoeWorktree : The term 'Initialize-MoeWorktree' is not recognized". WT-04 (5657d186) put `if ($AutoClaim -and $preflightOk -and $preflightTaskId -and $Role -eq 'worker') { Initialize-MoeWorktree ... }` inside the psContext slice (`    $dynamicContext = ""` → `    # -------- Pre-flight baseline`), and the test's ps1 preamble never stubs it. Likely fix: stub it in the preamble, as the sh side already passes. Found by WT-05 (task-c4cccb84) during its step-5 verification.
definitionOfDone: Windows node: `node --test scripts/tests/taskless-handoff.test.mjs` passes on powershell and pwsh (0 fail) without weakening any assertion
Linux node run of the same file stays green

implementationPlan.description: Fix only the PowerShell render preamble in scripts/tests/taskless-handoff.test.mjs. Existing claimed-worker/resume cases are the regression tests: psContext now includes the real WT-04 Initialize-MoeWorktree call, but intentionally excludes its definition. Before concatenating psContext, define a side-effect-free function Initialize-MoeWorktree([string]$TaskId, $Claim, $Context) {} with a brief comment that this fixture tests prompt rendering, not provisioning. Match the real positional signature; emit no pipeline/console output, invoke no Git/daemon/filesystem operation and do not source the full wrapper. Preserve every existing assertion, source anchor, engine matrix, fixture option and test case. Keep $ErrorActionPreference='Stop', spawn error handling, timeout/status assertions, record separators and temp-file finally cleanup untouched; do not hide failures with catch/Continue or disable claimed-worker branches. No launcher behavior or docs contract changes.
implementationPlan.note: Added no-op Initialize-MoeWorktree stub (real signature) to the ps1 preamble. 37 other dirty paths belong to other sessions; untouched.
